visualCharacteristics: Light grey background, two-column page-intro banner. Left column holds a large heading, supporting paragraph and two CTA buttons; right column holds a cluster of stacked/gridded images.
contentPattern: One row with a text cell (heading + paragraph + CTAs) and an image cell (image cluster). Cells are auto-detected by presence of images.
usage: Page-intro/hero banner with accompanying imagery, distinct from the full-bleed dark hero-overlay variant.
